calculation.description: Ranks assets that remain near their 60-day lows while exhibiting improving five-day returns, with the drawdown-recovery signal normalized by 20-day realized volatility and cross-sectionally demeaned. Uses only completed historical observations.

validation.regime_notes: No valid observations in 2020-2022 because the source series begins with insufficient aligned history. Positive H10 IC in 2023-2026 (0.184410), 2027-2030 (0.063646), 2031-2034 (0.026544), and 2035 YTD (0.025373). Small cross-asset universe and partial coverage require conservative interpretation.
